# Hero Image Spec — Waihanga (Construction)

**Purpose:** Static visual for V3 (proof-led) cold email + LinkedIn share card. Operator opens email, sees a real-looking evidence-pack mockup, recognises the SHAPE of a compliance document before reading a word of copy.

**Generated by:** Kate (Vessel Studio) OR delegated to a designer
**Saved to:** `/public/assets/hero/waihanga-evidence.png` in the repo, then deployed
**Final URL:** `https://www.assembl.co.nz/assets/hero/waihanga-evidence.png`

---

## Composition

- **Aspect ratio:** 16:9 (1600 × 900 px, retina 3200 × 1800 px)
- **Subject:** A flat-design rendering of an OPEN evidence-pack PDF lying on a warm cream paper background. Two pages visible — left page cover, right page citations.
- **Background:** Warm paper `#FAF7F2` (locked brand canon). NO photographic paper texture. Flat solid colour with a barely-perceptible noise overlay if needed.
- **Pack rendering:** Document drawn in flat illustration style — clean Cormorant Garamond headlines, IBM Plex Mono section labels, Inter body text. Brand-canon palette only.
- **Lighting:** Soft top-left to bottom-right gradient implied by a very subtle drop-shadow under each page. NO photographic light.
- **Vessel cameo:** Top-right corner of the image — a small Evidence Vessel motif (cream ceramic, pounamu glass plates, gold wire stand) at maybe 15% of canvas height. Visible but not dominant.

---

**Left page (cover):**
- Top eyebrow: `assembl · evidence pack` (IBM Plex Mono uppercase, taupe)

- Sub-line: `Residential Foundation Slab · 42 Greenlane Road West`

**Right page (citations):**

- Footer hash chain row: `7c4e2a8b...8a9b · sealed`

## Text overlay (embedded in image, not separate)

- **Top-left of canvas (above the pack):** small Cormorant italic caption: `Waihanga · s 14B Producer Statement · approved by Sarah Lim, CPEng 2891 · 12 March 2026`
- **Bottom-centre:** H1 statement: `Mahi that earns its proof.` (Cormorant Garamond, weight 300, large but not overwhelming the document)
- **No CTA in the image itself** — image is the proof, email/LinkedIn copy is the CTA

## Vessel Studio prompt (paste into `legacy-vite/public/tools/vessel-studio.html`)

```
A flat-design editorial composition. 16:9 aspect ratio. Warm cream paper
background (#FAF7F2 hex), no photographic texture. Subject: an open
two-page PDF document lying flat at slight perspective — left page is a
cover with the title "Section 14B Producer Statement Bundle" in
Cormorant Garamond, right page lists 5 citations with dates. Subtle
soft drop-shadows under each page. Top-right corner of the canvas:
a small Evidence Vessel motif — cream ceramic base, 3 stacked frosted
pounamu green glass plates, slim gold wire stand. Bottom-centre of
canvas: the text "Mahi that earns its proof." in Cormorant Garamond
weight 300. Style: Aesop catalogue meets editorial design, Cereal
magazine quietness, no neon, no glow effects, no AI shimmer. Flat
illustration, not photorealistic.
```

If Vessel Studio doesn't produce the document mockup well, consider Figma or Sketch — the pack is essentially typography, easier hand-laid.

---

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Aspect 16:9 (1600×900 minimum, retina preferred)
- [ ] Cream `#FAF7F2` background dominant ≥80%
- [ ] Pounamu `#2B6B57` only on document accents (citation rule, approval pill)
- [ ] Soft gold `#D9BC7A` (kete-gold token) for hairlines on the vessel cameo
- [ ] All text readable at LinkedIn thumbnail size (~400px wide)
- [ ] No AI shimmer / no neon / no glowing edges
- [ ] No bitmap photography
- [ ] Lowercase `assembl` if wordmark visible

---

**Time to generate (Vessel Studio + 1-2 retakes): ~5 minutes of Kate's time.**
